title: Concept: Passport machine-readable zone in a response
description: A passport machine-readable zone line (P< followed by an issuing-state code) in a response gives every reader of that response the same information the bank holds internally: The MRZ encodes name, document number, nationality, date of birth and expiry in a fixed format that any reader can parse, and it is accepted as proof of identity by many services.
applicability: An MRZ line is a complete identity document in text form, and it is enough to open accounts or pass automated verification elsewhere.
risk: The MRZ exists to be machine-read, which is exactly why it must not travel into a browser response.
